description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.
